purpose: Deterministic display-only stable-window example for explaining target-local versus matched-regional synthetic perturbations. It does not select a favorable result or contribute a new benchmark metric.

selection.rule: Select the lexicographically first case_id in the frozen held-out evaluation partition.

injection.magnitude_rule: Use the frozen benchmark additive magnitude: two times the robust 180/15 pre-anchor target scale times the declared multiplier.

display.series_scale: log1p concentration centered by the pre-anchor target/donor calibration offset
